## Bibliometrix software : [Option 1]{style="color:red;"}

:::{layout="[50,60]" layout-align="center"}
:::{}
1. **Sign-up an account**:

🔗 [https://posit.cloud/content/7229125](https://posit.cloud/content/7229125)

2. ⚠️ **Save permante copy**

::: {.callout-caution}
This is an online version that can be slow!
:::


:::
![](figures/posit/01.png){width="70%" fig-align="center"}
:::




## Bibliometrix software : [Option 2]{style="color:red;"}

1. Download R Project: [https://pbil.univ-lyon1.fr/CRAN/](https://pbil.univ-lyon1.fr/CRAN/)
2. Download RStudio: [https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/)
3. `install.packages("bibliometrix")` > Enter ⏎

![](figures/rstudio/install.png){width="40%" fig-align="center"}


## Bibliometrix software : Option 2

:::{layout="[50,50]" layout-valign="center"}

:::{}
4. Copy & Paste

```{.r code-line-numbers="1-5" }
library(bibliometrix)
biblioshiny()
```

5. Open an Internet page and put the address that appears in your `console`

![](figures/rstudio/run.png){fig-align="center"}
:::

![](figures/rstudio/run2.png){fig-align="center"}
:::
